verdict.rationale: Flagsmith documents an official CLI that manages flags, segments, features, projects and environments from the terminal and evaluates flags the way an SDK would; a probe confirmed the official CLI docs page exists. The evidence amounts to a single-sentence capability summary, so depth for agent-driven use is unproven. Missing for 10: documented AI-native ergonomics (machine-readable/JSON output, non-interactive auth), installation and command-reference depth, independent or hands-on corroboration.
